scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @maxim/contracts && npm run build --workspace @maxim/api && npm run build --workspace @maxim/miniapp
scripts.build:docker: docker build -f apps/api/Dockerfile -t maxim-api-ci . && docker build -f apps/miniapp/Dockerfile -t maxim-miniapp-ci .
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.check:api: npm run typecheck:api && npm run test:api
scripts.check:miniapp: npm run typecheck:miniapp && npm run test:miniapp
scripts.dev:all: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail -n api,miniapp -c blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @maxim/api" "npm run dev --workspace @maxim/miniapp"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @maxim/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace @maxim/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @maxim/miniapp
